community.name: Emerald City Leadership Network
community.setting: A light modern fictional Oz: the Emerald City and the Munchkin, Winkie, Quadling and Gillikin countries, with buses, clinics, mills, shops, civic offices and festivals. The echo of Oz is in names, places and temperaments; the work is ordinary modern work.
community.fictional_notice: Entirely fictional authoring facts. These are planning premises, not extracted evidence or verified biographies. Any resemblance to real people is unintended.
assumptions: The network is an invented association of 300 adult members. Rowan Bell is its community manager and is not a member.

Fifty-four members carry names used by StoryBank's fictional Emerald City cast; nine of them keep the facts used in the StoryBank playground (Dorothy Gale, Martin Woodward, Clara Micefield, Leona Bracken, Ruth Fenwick, Samuel Strawbridge, Oscar Diggs, Glinda Southwell, Jellia Jamb). These are new collection identities, not the community-life roster entries of the same names.

The other 246 members were generated deterministically (seed 20261022) from Oz-echo name pools with no duplicate full names; their background, voice and experience_domains text was drafted by a model and is authoring premise only.

Planted identity cases: Marcus Wren (ln034) and Lottie Wren (ln201) share a surname and are unrelated; Wilhelmina Thistlewaite (ln151) is known as Billie; one source mentions a non-member namesake of Peter Ash (ln037).
Home values are invented neighborhoods or settlements; district names one of the five areas. There are no real addresses or contact details.
Relationships are reciprocal acquaintance links within shared circles. They authorize no specific interaction.
Circles are interest and work groups inside the network; a member can belong to more than one.
